announcements.title: Club Dues
announcements.description: Pay your Math NHS required club dues by October 9th!

poster.description: Design a fun math problem, brain teaser, or joke that can challenge someone, make them think, or make them laugh between classes. Posters are worth 1 point, with one submission allowed per month.

events.title: Middle School Math Competition
events.description: We invite all of our feeder middle schools to BVSW for a friendly math competition with real trophies, treats for everyone, and a fun first look at the high-school math community.

events.title: STEM Fair
events.description: We partner with Science NHS to plan hands-on projects for families and friends to explore in the cafeteria. Past projects have ranged from elephant's toothpaste to mini pancakes, marshmallow builds, robotics, and homemade ice cream.

events.title: Pi Day
events.description: Math classes rotate through the lunchroom every hour for games, prizes, class point competitions, a pie-eating contest, jar guessing challenges, and more. Our members plan the activities, buy supplies, set up the space, and keep the day running.

events.title: General Meetings
events.description: Meetings combine quick club updates with activities ranging from math-field professionals speaking about their work to member-led group games.

events.title: T-Shirt Design Contest
events.description:
At the start of each year, members submit designs and earn bonus points for winning or placing as a runner-up. The winning design decides what we wear to every event for the rest of the year.

This event is happening now! Visit the provided submission link to upload your Canva design for consideration!

events.title: Math Posters
events.description: Members create clever math problems, brain teasers, and jokes to decorate the math hallways and give everyone something worth stopping to solve.

events_points.events_intro: Big traditions, service opportunities, and the projects our members help bring to life.
events_points.points_intro: Every way to earn points this year, in one table. Mix and match — there is no single required path.

important_links.title: Mathletics Volunteer Sign Up
important_links.description: Volunteers will help grade paper scores during the Liberty View Mathletics competition. The competition includes elementary students from Liberty View and Morse who are from 3rd to 5th grade.

important_links.title: STEM Career Talks Vote
important_links.description: Pick up to 3 types of STEM careers that you would like to hear from during a Math NHS Meeting!

important_links.description: Requirements in Google Form. Due October 31st!
